posts.name: 33-mind-crow-fast-decisions
posts.caption:
Crows can make a visual decision in under a quarter of a second, roughly twice as fast as earlier studies found for humans and monkeys 🐦‍⬛

Two carrion crows judged which way a cloud of moving dots drifted and pecked the answer in 235 milliseconds on average. Their brain cells signaled the choice before the beak moved. Caveat: only two birds, and people were not tested in the same experiment.

Source: Schmidt, Nieder (University of Tübingen), “Ultrarapid decision-making in an avian brain”, Science, 2026.
